cards.titleZh: 法显眼中的赋税与刑罚
cards.titleEn: Tax and punishment through Faxian’s eyes

locator.htmlSection: Chapter 16 — Condition and Customs of Central India
locator.section: 第16章，第8—13段（教学版） / Chapter 16, segments 8–13 (teaching edition)

cards.summaryZh: 法显写到耕种王地者缴纳收获的一部分，也描述依罪轻重罚钱、反复谋反者被截右手等处罚。把相邻段落连起来读，可以分清旅行见闻与成文法典各自提供的信息。
cards.summaryEn: Faxian describes dues from royal land, fines graded by the offence, and the cutting off of the right hand for repeated attempts at rebellion. Reading the adjacent passages together helps distinguish a travel account from a formal legal code.
cards.scopeZh: 第16章教学版第8—13段；与笈多帝国（320—550年）的成文法典原值P对读，观察年未注明。文中的“中国”指印度中部。
cards.scopeEn: Chapter 16, teaching-edition segments 8–13, alongside Gupta (320–550): formal legal code P, observation date unspecified. “Middle Kingdom” here refers to central India.
cards.sourceSnapshot: UCSD revised teaching edition, chapter page created 2012-11-24; retrieved 2026-10-06; not an unaltered 1886 transcription

cards.titleZh: 寺院供养如何留下凭据

locator.htmlSection: Chapter 16 — Of Monks, Viharas, and Monasteries
locator.section: 第16章，第19—21段（教学版） / Chapter 16, segments 19–21 (teaching edition)

cards.summaryZh: 第16章记述田宅、园圃与耕作资源的捐施，并以铁券记录、传付后王。将捐施凭据与随后列出的衣食卧具连读，可以理解寺院日常供养的物质基础。
cards.summaryEn: Chapter 16 describes gifts of fields, dwellings, gardens, and farming resources, recorded on metal plates and passed to later kings. Read these deeds beside the following account of clothing, food, and bedding to explore the material basis of monastic support.
cards.scopeZh: 教学版第19—21段；中文原文为“铁券书录”，英译用金属板概称，对应文字记录原值P。
cards.scopeEn: Teaching-edition segments 19–21 accompany written records P. The Chinese specifies iron deeds; the English translation uses the broader term metal plates.
cards.sourceSnapshot: UCSD revised teaching edition, chapter page created 2012-11-24; retrieved 2026-10-06; not an unaltered 1886 transcription

cards.titleZh: 从口传到抄本：法显在巴连弗求律
cards.titleEn: From oral transmission to manuscripts at Pataliputra

locator.htmlSection: Chapter 36 — In Patna; Transcription of Manuscripts and Indian Studies
locator.section: 第36章，第1—9段（教学版） / Chapter 36, segments 1–9 (teaching edition)

cards.summaryZh: 法显先在北印度遇到师徒口传的戒律，后来在巴连弗获得律本与其他佛教文献。第9段写他停留三年学习梵语、文字并抄写戒律，呈现求书、学习与传经怎样相互衔接。
cards.summaryEn: Faxian first encounters Vinaya rules transmitted orally in North India, then obtains manuscripts and other Buddhist works at Pataliputra. Segment 9 describes three years learning Sanskrit language and writing and copying the Vinaya, connecting acquisition, study, and transmission.
cards.scopeZh: 第36章教学版第1—9段；文字记录与宗教文献两项原值均为P，三年为叙事中的停留时长。
cards.scopeEn: Chapter 36, teaching-edition segments 1–9: written records and religious literature both have raw value P; three years is the duration reported in the narrative.
cards.sourceSnapshot: UCSD revised teaching edition, chapter page created 2012-11-24; retrieved 2026-10-06; not an unaltered 1886 transcription

cards.titleZh: 特诺奇蒂特兰的市场与裁断
authors: Jerome S. Arkenberg (scanning and text modernization)

locator.htmlSection: Market squares; merchandise streets; audience house and measures
locator.section: 市场段落 / Market passages (raw HTML lines 297–344)

cards.summaryZh: 科尔特斯写到按货物分区的街市，以及处理争执、巡查量器的人员。把商品陈列、纠纷裁断与度量监督放在一起，可以读出市场秩序的几个层面。
cards.summaryEn: Cortés describes merchandise grouped by street, people deciding disputes, and inspectors checking measures. Read the arrangement of goods alongside adjudication and inspection to explore several layers of market order.
cards.scopeZh: 1520年第二封信的市场段落；与阿兹特克帝国的市场P、法官P两项原记录对读。
cards.scopeEn: Market passages in the Second Letter of 1520, alongside Aztec raw rows for markets P and judges P.
cards.sourceSnapshot: Thatcher 1907 anthology excerpt of the 1520 letter; Arkenberg modernization, Fordham page © Paul Halsall June 1998; retrieved 2026-10-06

authors: Jerome S. Arkenberg (scanning and text modernization)

locator.htmlSection: Provincial governors, tribute collectors, and records on paper
locator.section: 贡赋与纸面记录 / Tribute and paper records (raw HTML lines 471–480)

cards.summaryZh: 信中描述各省按本地出产纳贡，并用纸上的符号与图像记录应纳物品。结合文字、非文字记录与助记工具三类条目，可以追问同一种记录方式在不同分类中如何被描述。
cards.summaryEn: The letter describes provinces rendering local products and recording their obligations with characters and figures on paper. Read this beside written records, non-written records, and mnemonic devices to examine how recording practices are classified.
cards.scopeZh: 贡赋段落；助记工具P、非文字记录P、文字记录A均保留为原始编码。
cards.scopeEn: Tribute passage; mnemonic devices P, non-written records P, and written records A are preserved as raw coding.
